stories.title: Deepika Padukone stars in Hilton campaign
stories.summary: Hilton has launched a new global marketing campaign featuring Deepika Padukone. The effort, which includes digital and outdoor advertising, focuses on the idea that a hotel stay helps travellers feel at ease. The campaign was filmed at the Conrad Bengaluru and will continue throughout the year.

stories.title: KFC campaign puts a saucy twist on Indian cinematic storytelling - Creative Review
Philadelphia increases holiday marketing spend
stories.summary: The brand is increasing its seasonal investment by 15 percent and bringing back its Phillyboy character in a Santa-like role. The campaign focuses on cheesecake as the brand undergoes a revamp.

stories.title: Jell-O launches largest marketing investment in a decade
stories.summary: The Kraft Heinz brand has introduced a new creative platform developed by Johannes Leonardo. The campaign represents the company's largest marketing investment in more than ten years and aims to shift consumer perceptions of the product.

stories.title: Madhuri Dixit named brand ambassador for BoroPlus
stories.summary: Emami has appointed actor Madhuri Dixit as the brand ambassador for BoroPlus. The company has unveiled a winter campaign titled A Perfect Gift for Family, which was produced by RH Films. The brand says the campaign centres on the idea that care often lies in family.

stories.title: Shubman Gill fronts Tata Capital loan campaign
stories.summary: Tata Capital has launched a public awareness campaign featuring cricketer Shubman Gill as Inspector Gill. The films urge consumers to consider loan terms and implications before borrowing. The initiative arrives as digital applications and instant approvals have made access to credit quicker.

stories.title: Gold Spot returns to India after 26 years
stories.summary: Coca-Cola is relaunching the orange-flavoured beverage Gold Spot after a 26-year absence. The brand will return in low-sugar and sugar-free variants. The company says the move aims to revive the legacy drink without impacting sales of Fanta.

stories.title: Bhima Gold launches bridal jewellery campaign
stories.summary: Bhima Gold has launched a bridal jewellery campaign featuring Janhvi Kapoor. The initiative focuses on how contemporary brides incorporate family customs into their celebrations while maintaining personal identities. The brand positions its jewellery as a keepsake associated with wedding traditions.

stories.title: TBWA\Hakuhodo wins Best of Show at ONE Asia Creative Awards
stories.summary: TBWA\Hakuhodo Tokyo was named Agency of the Year at the 2026 ONE Asia Creative Awards. The agency also won Best of Show for its Radio Time Machine project. The awards recognize creative work from 13 countries and regions across the Asia-Pacific.

stories.title: Hyderabad OTS Advertising wins dual recognition
stories.summary: Hyderabad-based OTS Advertising was named runner-up for Independent Agency of the Year at the e4m Media Ace Awards. Managing director Venkat Jagdish Nalluri received the Independent Agency Head of the Year award. The agency was founded in 1978.

stories.title: Indian agencies win 15 awards at ONE Asia Creative Awards
stories.summary: Indian agencies secured 15 awards and merits at the 2026 ONE Asia Creative Awards. Mumbai-based Juice led the contingent with a Best of Discipline win for its Air India Express campaign. 22feet also received multiple honours for work created for Godawan Diageo India.

stories.title: Indian agencies earn 15 honours at ONE Asia Creative Awards
stories.summary: Indian agencies secured 15 awards and merits at the 2026 ONE Asia Creative Awards. Juice won Best of Discipline in Design for its Air India Express campaign, while 22feet received four honours for its work with Godawan Diageo India.

stories.title: Special and Colenso BBDO lead ANZ wins at ONE Asia
stories.summary: Agencies in Australia and New Zealand won 15 awards and merits at the 2026 ONE Asia Creative Awards. Special Australia led with wins for Uber Eats, while Colenso BBDO Auckland took all of New Zealand's awards for its work with Skinny.

stories.title: Publicis London Strengthens Strategy Team with Senior Hires and Promotion , LBB - LBB - Little Black Book
BBDO Group India appoints Ashish Chakravarty as CCO
stories.summary: BBDO Group India has appointed Ashish Chakravarty as chief creative officer. He joins from Garage Worldwide and will work alongside chairman Josy Paul. Chakravarty has previously held leadership roles at McCann and Contract Advertising.

stories.title: Infectious Advertising appoints two creative directors
stories.summary: Infectious Advertising has appointed Sumit Bansode as creative director for art and Harish Nair as creative director for copy. Bansode joins with 13 years of experience in digital advertising, while Nair brings over a decade of experience in the sector.

stories.title: Vaishali Verma steps down as Initiative India CEO
stories.summary: Vaishali Verma has stepped down as CEO of Initiative India after a leadership tenure at the media agency. Verma, who has 29 years of experience in the industry, stated she is leaving to explore new professional opportunities.

stories.title: Perspective - Creator marketing passed the test in 2026 so why are we still budgeting it like a trial? - AdNews
Influencer boxing explained
stories.summary: Influencer boxing, which began with the KSI and Logan Paul fights of 2018, now features social media personalities fighting professionals. Misfits Boxing, founded in 2022, holds a five-year DAZN deal. The sport has moved from viral spectacle to licensed title cards. The punches are now professional.

stories.title: One video, multiple ads
stories.summary: Brands are shifting how they use creator content, moving beyond simple sponsored posts. Influencer videos are increasingly repurposed as advertising assets for paid media campaigns. The boundaries between influencer marketing, content production and performance advertising are blurring, as brands demand more utility from their creator partnerships.

stories.title: Influencer fees stagnate
stories.summary: India's creator economy is expanding, but individual influencer fees have largely plateaued. As influencer marketing becomes a mainstream advertising service, the growing supply of creators has changed the economics. Premium rates now depend on factors beyond follower count as the market matures and pricing becomes standardised.

stories.title: Brands add no-AI clauses to creator deals
stories.summary: Brands are increasingly including language in influencer contracts that prohibits the use of AI in campaign content. According to Pearpop vp of talent Kurt Stadelman, the addendums are becoming a focal point as brands tighten control over usage rights and exclusivity in the creator economy.

stories.title: Brands seek strategic value from influencer agencies
stories.summary: India's influencer agency ecosystem is growing, but brands are struggling with low entry barriers and inconsistent quality. Industry experts suggest that marketers should prioritize agencies that align creator campaigns with specific business objectives, rather than simply focusing on the size of an agency's creator list.

stories.title: Comedian brand partnership fees
stories.summary: India's comedians command partnership fees ranging from 1 lakh to upwards of 75 lakh rupees. While entry-level artists charge around 1 to 2 lakh, top-tier talent can command significantly higher amounts. There is no standard rate card, as fees depend on the scope of work and partnership structure.

stories.title: Cashify shifts marketing budget to YouTube
stories.summary: Cashify now allocates 20 percent of its marketing budget to YouTube as it expands partnerships into regional markets. The company reported a consolidated net profit of 6.49 crore rupees in FY26, reversing a previous loss. Revenue from operations grew 50 percent to 1,641.19 crore rupees.

stories.title: YouTube packages creators as premium entertainment
stories.summary: YouTube is positioning its creators as a premium network, presenting a slate of world-class, studio-quality programming. The platform aims to move beyond endless uploads, packaging projects in food, travel and reality formats as destination entertainment. YouTube wants its content sold like a traditional television network.

stories.title: Nexxen partners with Gracenote for CTV targeting
stories.summary: Nexxen has integrated Gracenote's content intelligence into its supply-side platform to enable program-level targeting for connected TV advertising. The partnership aims to give advertisers more visibility into the specific content surrounding their ad placements, addressing a traditional limitation in CTV inventory planning.

stories.title: Meta and AppLovin pressure independent ad tech
stories.summary: Meta is exploring connected TV advertising while AppLovin reportedly considers an acquisition of Criteo. The moves add pressure to independent ad tech firms, which have reported challenging circumstances in recent earnings calls. The squeeze on the independent sector continues as platforms expand their reach.

stories.title: Amazon buys ChatGPT ads while blocking crawlers
stories.summary: Amazon is paying OpenAI to display Black Friday ads within ChatGPT, despite blocking OpenAI's crawlers from its own site. The ads appear as standard promotional units with a call to action. The e-commerce giant is happy to reach users on the platform it refuses to let study.

stories.title: Pinterest integrates with Microsoft Ads
stories.summary: Pinterest has announced a new integration that will extend its ad placements across Microsoft's partner platforms. The move expands the reach of Pinterest's advertising inventory through the Microsoft network.

stories.title: Nexxen and Gracenote bring program-level targeting to CTV
stories.summary: Nexxen has partnered with Nielsen's Gracenote to integrate CTV data into its supply-side platform. The move allows advertisers to target specific programs rather than relying on broader audience metrics. Brands are seeking greater control over the environments where their connected TV ads appear.

stories.title: BADBOX 3.0 ad fraud scheme uncovered
stories.summary: HUMAN Security has disrupted an ad fraud operation that generated 40 billion fraudulent requests daily. The scheme used compromised Android TV boxes to impersonate streaming apps and generate fake ad activity. The operation accounted for 4 percent of observed CTV traffic, raising questions about current fraud detection.

stories.title: Brands boost holiday media spending
stories.summary: Brands are expected to spend 10 to 30 percent more on digital media this Black Friday and Cyber Monday compared to 2025. Retail media, search and CTV are projected to capture much of the growth. Last year, 33,000 U.S. brands spent 607 million dollars during the period.

stories.title: YouTube adds co-view counts to CTV metrics
stories.summary: YouTube will now report connected TV view counts based on television industry standards. The platform is applying these new metrics across all formats moving forward to better align with traditional TV measurement.

stories.title: YouTube Shorts algorithm prioritizes original content
stories.summary: YouTube updated its Shorts recommendation system on October 1 to prioritize original content. The change reduces the reach of aggregator channels that repost clips with minimal modifications. The platform is shifting algorithmic weight toward creators producing their own material rather than repurposing existing content.

stories.title: Attentive launches MCP on Snowflake Marketplace
stories.summary: Attentive has launched its Model Context Protocol on Snowflake Marketplace. The company claims the integration allows marketers to use natural-language prompts to manage segments, draft copy and retrieve brand assets alongside business data. The platform aims to help customers make faster decisions and drive stronger performance.

stories.title: OpenClips offers AI video generation for ads
stories.summary: OpenClips.AI claims its tool turns product links or photos into launch-ready video ads without filming or editing. The platform provides templates organized by industry and promises users see the price of every creative before spending money. It says most AI video tools deliver only slop.

stories.title: IPQualityScore launches no-code fraud prevention tool
stories.summary: IPQualityScore has launched Fraud Flows, a no-code tool for building fraud controls for customer signups and account recovery. The company says the software helps teams turn fraud intelligence into risk-based decisions without engineering time. It addresses issues like fake accounts, suspicious orders and account takeover attempts.

stories.title: Rezolve Ai reports search volume jump at Flowtech
stories.summary: Rezolve Ai says on-site search volume at industrial group Flowtech rose 185 percent in the four months following its platform deployment. The company tracks which searches turn into orders across Flowtech websites in the UK, Ireland and Benelux. Flowtech reported annual revenue of 116.9 million pounds.

stories.title: WP Engine adds AI tools to managed hosting
stories.summary: WP Engine has introduced managed AI infrastructure to its hosting platform, aiming to make WordPress sites AI-ready without requiring a full replatforming. The company says it wants to help organizations prepare for the agentic web. WordPress currently powers 40 percent of the web.

stories.title: Adelaide startup P3 State raises 9.5 million dollars
stories.summary: Adelaide-based P3 State has raised 9.5 million dollars to reduce AI training and compute costs. Led by Main Sequence and DCVC, the company plans to hire staff and prepare its technology for a future public release. The startup aims to maintain performance while lowering expenses for developers.

stories.title: MFour adds Google AI Mode to consumer data feed
stories.summary: MFour has added Google AI Mode to its conversation data feed, which already tracks ChatGPT and Gemini. The company claims it collects 2.8 million consumer AI conversations every 30 days. It says it is the only platform connecting these conversations to actual consumer behavior in stores.

stories.title: Perform.AI releases readiness checker for shopping agents
stories.summary: Perform.AI has launched a free tool designed to check if online stores are ready for agentic commerce. The company says retailers must now sell to both human shoppers and AI agents that compare offers. The tool claims to identify gaps in store infrastructure in under one minute.

research.title: Beyond Invoice Volumes: Temporal Network Structure, Maturity Concentration, and Systemic Liquidity Exposure in SME Trade-Credit Networks
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Trade-credit invoices encode directed obligations whose temporal synchronization and counterparty concentration are obscured by annual volume totals. We audit 749,952 atomic B2B invoices from 2012-2023 (EUR 99.705B, 75,343 firms) from the pseudonymized Mendeley Data corpus (Esteva. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

Analyzing their frequency distribution provides deep insights into the local structure of graphs, with applications in social network analysis, bioinformatics, and web mining. However, exact. This task is challenging with event-centered freeze-frame observations, a broadcast-like setting that provides only partial. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Investigating Forecasting Capabilities of Narrative Networks on Emerging Stories
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Networks have been used to model the interactions among the elements that underlie a narrative. In this paper, we investigate whether the structure of these networks can predict which links will emerge as a storyline evolves. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

While rumor dissemination forms complex structural patterns, existing detection methods often fail to capture the intricate interplay between textual coherence and. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: LLMs for Qualitative and Mixed-Methods Social Network Analysis
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: This manuscript explores the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into the field of qualitative and mixed-methods social network analysis (SNA). We argue that the primary focus of this integration should be on enhancing the depth. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Learn to Vaccinate: Combining Structure Learning and Effective Vaccination for Epidemic and Outbreak Control
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The Susceptible-Infected-Susceptible (SIS) model is a widely used model for the spread of information and infectious diseases, particularly non-immunizing ones, on a graph. Given a highly contagious disease, a natural question is how to best vaccinate. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
